```python
def run_dijkstra(fab, g):
    V = fab.V; N = fab.N
    indptr = fab.indptr; edst = fab.edst; mkey = fab.mkey
    egmax = fab.egmax; ekind = fab.ekind; wkey = fab.wkey
    SH = fab.SHIFT; VM = fab.VMASK
    best = [None] * V
    prevv = [-1] * V
    prevk = [0] * V
    heap = []
    push = heapq.heappush; pop = heapq.heappop
    for v in fab.anchor_verts:
        best[v] = 0
        push(heap, v)
    while heap:
        item = pop(heap)
        nk = item >> SH
        v = item & VM
        if best[v] != nk:
            continue
        w = v + N
        if w >= V: w -= V
        kk = nk + wkey[v]
        bw = best[w]
        if bw is None or kk < bw:
            best[w] = kk; prevv[w] = v; prevk[w] = -1
            push(heap, (kk << SH) | w)
        s = indptr[v]; e = indptr[v+1]
        while s < e:
            if egmax[s] >= g:
                nv = edst[s]
                kk = nk + mkey[s]
                b = best[nv]
                if b is None or kk < b:
                    best[nv] = kk; prevv[nv] = v; prevk[nv] = ekind[s]
                    push(heap, (kk << SH) | nv)
            s += 1
    return best, prevv, prevk
```
